levels.surface: عبيد الله بن أبي عبد الله الأغر

notes: Zayd b. Rabah and Ubayd Allah are co-transmitters in one level; the next level is shared, so the tool expands two routes through the same Abu Abd Allah al-Aghar (occurrence 2: the first occurrence is inside «عبيد الله بن أبي عبد الله الأغر»)
The Prophet is the end; «رضى الله عنه» is left out
